requirements.text: Every on-board FDIR monitor shall be enabled, disabled and given new limits by telecommand.
requirements.rationale: Derived from F9.1 (PUS service 12): limits must be tunable in flight after commissioning.
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-PFM-DITL

requirements.text: The model philosophy shall be breadboard (month 6), engineering model (month 18) and protoflight model (month 30), with the final vibration test in the deployer performed by the launch provider.
requirements.rationale: 36-month development with launch at about month 36; protoflight saves a qualification model.
requirements.source_ref: NFI brief (BB m6, EM m18, FM m30); ECSS-E-ST-10-02C
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, confirmed by review in RV-PDR-VER

requirements.text: Every requirement shall have a verification method, verification level and close-out stage recorded in the verification control document, and be closed with evidence before the acceptance review.
requirements.rationale: Methods T, A, R, I (demonstration is a test, ECSS-E-ST-10-02C); A- or R-only items need a risk assessment.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, confirmed by review in RV-PDR-VER

requirements.text: The flight model shall pass protoflight sine and random vibration in all three axes with a first-mode frequency shift of at most 5 % between the pre- and post-test resonance surveys.
requirements.rationale: Protoflight levels from the launch ICD or GEVS; the launch-provider vibration in the deployer comes after.
requirements.acceptance: <= 5 % first-mode shift, measured in TS-PFM-VIB

requirements.text: The flight model shall pass a protoflight thermal-vacuum test of at least 4 cycles at a pressure of at most 1e-5 hPa, with functional tests at each hot and cold plateau.
requirements.rationale: Also the opportunity to check payload focus in vacuum and to correlate the thermal model.
requirements.acceptance: >= 4 thermal cycles, measured in TS-PFM-TVAC

requirements.text: A full functional test of the flight model shall be run before and after each environmental test and before delivery.
requirements.rationale: Detects degradation caused by each test.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-PFM-FUN

requirements.text: An end-to-end test shall send encrypted telecommands from mission control through at least 2 ground stations over RF to the flight model and return an image pair that the science segment processes to Level-1C.
requirements.rationale: Exercises the whole chain, including keys, VPN and the processing chain, before launch.
requirements.acceptance: >= 2 ground stations in the test, measured in TS-PFM-E2E

requirements.text: A day-in-the-life test of at least 72 h on the flight model shall run a stored plan without commanding, including a command-loss recovery to Safe mode.
requirements.rationale: Shows 48 h autonomy and the 72 h command-loss response on flight hardware.
requirements.acceptance: >= 72 h, measured in TS-PFM-DITL

requirements.text: Each release circuit of the sail and the independent timer (in accelerated mode) shall be tested on the flight model, with full sail, antenna and wing deployments tested on the engineering model.
requirements.rationale: Drag-sail deployment reliability is a top risk; ARTICA's only flight has no published deployment result.
requirements.source_ref: NFI brief (sail reliability risk); research: bus R4
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-PFM-DEP

requirements.text: The flight payload shall be calibrated before delivery for relative radiometric response with an integrating sphere, for spectral response of each flight filter and for the inter-camera boresight map with focus set in vacuum.
requirements.rationale: Calibration baseline for O4; in-orbit cross-calibration then tracks changes.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-PFM-CAL

requirements.text: All flight hardware assembly shall follow ECSS-Q-ST-70-61C or IPC J-STD-001 Class 3 with the space addendum, under an ANSI/ESD S20.20 ESD-control programme.
requirements.rationale: Student-built boards and harness; workmanship is the dominant early-failure cause in CubeSats.
requirements.source_ref: ECSS-Q-ST-70-61C or IPC J-STD-001 Class 3 Space Addendum; ANSI/ESD S20.20
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, confirmed by inspection in IN-EM-VER

requirements.text: The VNIR band shall be centred at 865 +-10 nm with a full width at half maximum of at most 50 nm.
requirements.rationale: Matches Sentinel-2 B8A/B11 and OLI B5/B6; T-01 moved the SWIR filter from 1550 to about 1610 nm. VNIR FWHM 50 nm admits the COTS 875/50 filter.
requirements.source_ref: research: mission analysis R10, §6.4; research: payload §2.4; trade T-01
requirements.acceptance: <= 100 nm SWIR FWHM, measured in TS-EM-PAY

requirements.text: The SWIR band shall be centred between 1600 and 1630 nm with a full width at half maximum of at most 100 nm.
requirements.rationale: Split from PAY-OPT-01 (one measurable 'shall' per requirement). Matches Sentinel-2 B8A/B11 and OLI B5/B6; T-01 moved the SWIR filter from 1550 to about 1610 nm. VNIR FWHM 50 nm admits the COTS 875/50 filter.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-EM-PAY

requirements.text: Each bandpass filter shall block out-of-band light with optical density at least 4 over the detector response range (400-1700 nm for SWIR, 300-1100 nm for VNIR) outside its passband.
requirements.rationale: The InGaAs IMX992 sees the visible at about 70 % QE and the solar spectrum peaks there; a small visible leak would dominate the SWIR signal.
requirements.acceptance: >= 4 OD out-of-band, measured in TS-EM-PAY

requirements.text: The SWIR ground sample distance shall be at most 75 m (goal 60 m) at nadir from 600 km and at most 75 m along-track up to 25 deg off-nadir.
requirements.rationale: 58.2 m at 590 km with 35 mm focal length and 3.45 um pixels; 65 x 73 m at 25 deg.
requirements.source_ref: NFI brief; research: payload §3.1; research: mission analysis §1.4
requirements.acceptance: <= 75 m SWIR GSD, shown by analysis in AN-PAY

requirements.text: The common-grid swath of the two bands shall be at least 140 km at nadir over the accepted injection range 550-600 km.
requirements.rationale: SWIR swath 150.7 km and VNIR 172.3 km at 590 km; the revisit analysis assumed 150 km. ECP-02: at 550 km the common swath is 140.5 km, which just meets the requirement.
requirements.acceptance: >= 140 km common swath at 550 km (worst case of the range), shown by analysis in AN-PAY

requirements.text: The system MTF of each band at its native Nyquist frequency shall be at least 0.2 in orbit, with focus set in vacuum and held over bench temperatures from 0 to 25 degC.
requirements.rationale: Depth of focus is ±6-14 um, of the order of the air-to-vacuum and thermal focus shifts: focus in TVAC or with a measured offset, then stake.
requirements.acceptance: >= 0.2 system MTF at Nyquist, measured in TS-EM-PAY

requirements.text: On the 60 m product grid the SNR of each band shall be at least 30 for a 10 % reflectance target at 30 deg sun elevation.
requirements.rationale: Burn scars. Met with an f/1.4-1.8 SWIR lens and an f/2.4-2.8 VNIR lens binned 2 x 2 to 60 m (research: payload §3.4).
requirements.acceptance: >= 30 SNR, shown by analysis in AN-PAY

requirements.text: On the 60 m product grid the SNR of each band shall be at least 10 for a 2 % reflectance target at 15 deg sun elevation.
requirements.rationale: Open water at freeze-up; SWIR native is marginal in October at f/1.8, so 2 x 2 binning or high-conversion-gain mode is used late season.
requirements.source_ref: NFI brief; research: payload §3.4; research: mission analysis §1.5
requirements.acceptance: >= 10 SNR, shown by analysis in AN-PAY

requirements.text: Neither band shall saturate on a 0.95 reflectance target at 65 deg sun elevation using the seasonal exposure table.
requirements.rationale: The IMX542 saturates on fresh snow at f/2.4 and 2.3 ms in June; exposures of 1-1.5 ms are needed over spring snow.
requirements.acceptance: >= 0.95 reflectance unsaturated, measured in TS-PFM-CAL

requirements.text: Band-to-band registration on the product grid shall be at most 1.0 SWIR pixel RMS (goal 0.5) using the bench boresight map.
requirements.rationale: Two cameras on one rigid bench; the boresight map is measured on the ground and updated in orbit.
requirements.acceptance: <= 1.0 SWIR px RMS, measured in IOV-COM

requirements.text: Both cameras shall operate in global-shutter mode only, with the IMX992 DRRS rolling-shutter mode disabled in flight software.
requirements.rationale: Rolling shutter adds row-dependent shear at 6.9 km/s ground speed.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, confirmed by inspection in IN-EM-PAY

requirements.text: The inter-camera boresight map shall be known to within 0.3 SWIR pixel RMS after ground calibration.
requirements.rationale: Allocation of SYS-BUD-13 (VER-CAL-01 measures it).
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.3 SWIR px RMS, measured in TS-PFM-CAL

requirements.text: The residual of each camera's geometric distortion model shall be at most 0.3 SWIR pixel RMS over the common field.
requirements.rationale: Allocation of SYS-BUD-13.
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.3 SWIR px RMS, shown by analysis in AN-PAY

requirements.text: Both cameras shall be triggered together from the GNSS PPS-disciplined clock and each frame time-tagged to within 1 ms of GNSS time.
requirements.rationale: 1 ms is about 7 m along track, well inside the geolocation budget.
requirements.source_ref: NFI brief (GNSS time stamp); research: bus §6
requirements.acceptance: <= 1 ms time-tag error, measured in TS-EM-PAY

requirements.text: The SWIR camera shall provide a night mode with exposures up to 50 ms and a dark frame acquired within 60 s of each night image.
requirements.rationale: O2 radiometry; beyond about 50 ms smear exceeds 6 pixels and dark current dominates (research: payload §3.5).
requirements.acceptance: <= 60 s to dark frame, measured in TS-EM-PAY

requirements.text: The payload controller shall produce quicklooks and 15 km region-of-interest pairs on the 60 m grid and compress all downlinked products losslessly (CCSDS 121.0 or 123.0) with a mean ratio of at least 1.3:1 (goal 1.5:1) on 12-bit data.
requirements.rationale: The planned product set (16.7 MB raw per day) fits the 13 MB/day post-compression target only with at least 1.28:1; CCSDS 121 typically gives 1.5-2:1 on 12-bit EO data (est., to be verified on simulated scenes). Lossless keeps the radiometry for O4.
requirements.acceptance: >= 1.3 mean lossless compression ratio, measured in TS-EM-PAY

requirements.text: The payload controller shall provide at least 8 GB of non-volatile product storage protected by per-file CRC and periodic scrubbing.
requirements.rationale: 7 days of planned acquisitions; the controller has no ECC RAM, so integrity is checked in software.
requirements.acceptance: >= 8 GB usable store, measured in TS-EM-PAY

requirements.text: The delay between the PPS-referenced trigger time and the start of each camera exposure shall be known to within 0.2 ms.
requirements.rationale: Allocation of the timing budget SYS-BUD-12 (capture latency + camera latency). [ASSUMPTION: Alvium trigger latency; measure on the breadboard.]
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.2 ms, measured in TS-EM-PAY

requirements.text: The payload shall set the exposure time and gain of each acquisition from an exposure table that can be loaded by telecommand.
requirements.rationale: Derived from F1.4: the seasonal exposure table that keeps snow below full well (RSK-021) had no requirement.
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-EM-PAY

requirements.text: The payload shall acquire a dark-frame set of both cameras at least once per day on the night side and update its hot-pixel map at least once per month.
requirements.rationale: No shutter; InGaAs hot pixels grow in orbit (CUMULOS) and DSNU depends on temperature.
requirements.acceptance: >= 1 dark-frame set per day, measured in IOV-COM

requirements.text: The payload mass (cameras, lenses, filters, bench, baffles, controller and payload harness), current best estimate plus equipment maturity margin, shall not exceed its allocation of 0.76 kg.
requirements.rationale: Allocation ledger (budgets.yaml mass.PAY). v1 capped the CBE at 0.70 kg, but CBE 0.65 kg plus maturity margins (10 % on the modified cameras, 20 % on the new controller carrier, bench and harness) is 0.748 kg [Calculated], so v1 left no room for the maturity margin that ECSS allocations must hold.
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.76 kg, measured in TS-EM-PAY

requirements.text: The payload shall fit within a 1U volume (100 mm of stack height) including its baffles.
requirements.rationale: Volume part of v1 PAY-BUD-01. Stack budget: 295 of 328 mm usable (SYS-BUD-08).
requirements.acceptance: <= 100 mm stack height, confirmed by inspection in IN-EM-PAY

requirements.text: The payload power shall be at most 12 W during acquisition.
requirements.rationale: 2.7 + 3.8 W cameras plus a 3-5 W CM4-class controller gives 11.5 W, budgeted as about 12 W (research: payload §3.7, §4).
requirements.acceptance: <= 12 W, measured in TS-EM-PAY

requirements.text: The payload power shall be at most 3 W while transferring data to the on-board computer.
requirements.rationale: Split from PAY-BUD-02 (one measurable 'shall' per requirement). 2.7 + 3.8 W cameras plus a 3-5 W CM4-class controller gives 11.5 W, budgeted as about 12 W (research: payload §3.7, §4).
requirements.acceptance: <= 3 W, measured in TS-EM-PAY

requirements.text: The payload orbit-average power in the nominal operations mix, including maturity margin, shall not exceed its allocation of 1.10 W.
requirements.rationale: Calculated 0.92 W from the mode matrix, 1.07 W with maturity margins.
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 1.1 W, shown by analysis in AN-BUD

requirements.text: The payload shall queue for downlink on average at most 13.0 MB per day of compressed products, averaged over any 7 days.
requirements.rationale: Data allocation (budgets.yaml data): the science allocation of the 25.26 MB/day channel.
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 13.0 MB/day, shown by analysis in AN-BUD

requirements.text: The solar arrays shall deliver at least 12 W orbit-average at end of life at beta 15 deg in the nominal attitude.
requirements.rationale: Body + two deployed wings give 12.2 W EOL; body-only gives 4.0 W, which does not close at low beta.
requirements.acceptance: >= 12 W orbit average EOL, shown by analysis in AN-PWR

requirements.text: Each solar wing shall deploy through two redundant release elements and report its deployed state by a switch.
requirements.rationale: Derived from F10.3: the wings carry about two thirds of the EOL power but v1 had no deployment requirement.
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-PFM-DEP

requirements.text: The battery shall have a capacity of at least 40 Wh at beginning of life.
requirements.rationale: BP4 43 Wh; BPX 86 Wh is 500 g and 41 mm for a 1.6 Wh eclipse need.
requirements.acceptance: >= 40 Wh, measured in TS-EM-EPS

requirements.text: The battery shall retain at least 80 % of its beginning-of-life capacity after 3 years of cycling at the planned depth of discharge.
requirements.rationale: Split from EPS-BAT-01 (one measurable 'shall' per requirement). BP4 43 Wh; BPX 86 Wh is 500 g and 41 mm for a 1.6 Wh eclipse need.
requirements.acceptance: >= 80 % of BOL capacity, shown by analysis in AN-PWR

requirements.text: The EPS shall supply a total spacecraft load of 20 W for at least 5 min in sunlight or eclipse.
requirements.rationale: Peak simultaneous load is about 19.6 W; within the P60 4 A battery limit.
requirements.acceptance: >= 20 W peak for 5 min, measured in TS-EM-EPS

requirements.text: Every switched output to a unit without radiation test data shall be current-limited with latch-up detection that trips within 10 ms and retries at most 3 times before latching off.
requirements.rationale: No TID/SEE data for the Alvium cameras, IMX992, IMX542 or CM4; latch-up protection and power cycling are the mitigation.
requirements.acceptance: <= 10 ms trip time, measured in TS-EM-EPS

requirements.text: The battery shall be kept at or above 0 degC while charging by its integrated heater under EPS control.
requirements.rationale: Li-ion charging below 0 degC plates lithium.
requirements.acceptance: >= 0 degC while charging, measured in TS-EM-EPS

requirements.text: The battery shall use UN 38.3-tested cells with over-charge, over-discharge, over-current and short-circuit protection.
requirements.rationale: Launch-provider safety acceptance of lithium-ion batteries.
requirements.source_ref: CDS rev 14.1 (battery); UN 38.3; launch provider safety
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, confirmed by inspection in IN-PFM-SAF

requirements.text: The EPS shall keep every load unpowered while the deployment switches are depressed or the remove-before-flight pin is inserted, through at least 3 independent inhibits (TBC against the launch ICD).
requirements.rationale: Deployer safety; the number of inhibits is set by the CDS revision and the launch ICD.
requirements.source_ref: CDS rev 14.1 (deployment switches, RBF); launch ICD
requirements.acceptance: >= 3 independent inhibits (TBC), measured in TS-PFM-FUN
requirements.open_item_note: open item carried from v1; TBC in text

requirements.text: The EPS shall permanently isolate the battery from the solar arrays on an authenticated two-step ARM and FIRE command.
requirements.rationale: Passivation at end of life after sail confirmation.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-PFM-FUN

requirements.text: The EPS mass, current best estimate plus maturity margin, shall not exceed its allocation of 1.75 kg.
requirements.rationale: Margined 1.71 kg with the DMSA wings at 10 % until the datasheet arrives [Calculated].
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 1.75 kg, shown by analysis in AN-BUD

requirements.text: The EPS own orbit-average consumption including the battery heater and maturity margin shall not exceed its allocation of 1.00 W.
requirements.rationale: Calculated 0.90 W, 0.95 W with maturity margin.
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 1.0 W, shown by analysis in AN-BUD

requirements.text: During imaging and night-SWIR acquisitions, in sunlight or eclipse, the ADCS shall control the payload boresight to within 1.0 deg (absolute pointing error, 3 sigma) of the commanded target attitude.
requirements.rationale: 0.08 deg leaves 0.05 deg for payload alignment in the 0.1 deg budget. Sun sensor plus magnetometer gives 0.2 deg (2 sigma) and nothing in eclipse, so a star tracker is required.
requirements.source_ref: NFI brief; research: bus §1 (star tracker needed)
requirements.acceptance: <= 1.0 deg (3 sigma), shown by analysis in AN-PNT

requirements.text: During imaging and night-SWIR acquisitions the ADCS shall know the attitude of the star-tracker frame to within 0.08 deg (3 sigma).
requirements.rationale: Split from ADC-PNT-01 (one measurable 'shall' per requirement). 0.08 deg leaves 0.05 deg for payload alignment in the 0.1 deg budget. Sun sensor plus magnetometer gives 0.2 deg (2 sigma) and nothing in eclipse, so a star tracker is required.
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.08 deg (3 sigma), shown by analysis in AN-PNT

requirements.text: The ADCS shall slew 30 deg in roll and settle to within 1 deg of the target attitude within 60 s.
requirements.rationale: Average 0.75 deg/s including settling; check against 1.77 mNms wheels with the deployed-panel inertia.
requirements.acceptance: <= 60 s slew and settle (30 deg), measured in TS-PFM-FUN

requirements.text: The alignment between the star tracker and the payload boresight shall be known to within 0.05 deg (3 sigma) after in-orbit calibration.
requirements.rationale: Ground alignment drifts with launch loads; in-orbit calibration uses registration to Sentinel-2/Landsat.
requirements.source_ref: design allocation of the 0.1 deg budget
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.05 deg alignment knowledge, measured in IOV-COM

requirements.text: After separation the ADCS shall reduce body rates from 10 deg/s to below 0.5 deg/s within 3 orbits using magnetic B-dot control.
requirements.rationale: LEOP exit criterion; B-dot needs only the magnetometer and torquers.
requirements.acceptance: <= 3 orbits, shown by analysis in AN-PNT

requirements.text: In Safe mode the ADCS shall point the solar arrays to within 10 deg of the Sun within 1 orbit using only sun sensors, magnetometer, gyros, wheels and torquers.
requirements.rationale: Safe mode must not depend on the star tracker or GNSS, which are shed below 20 % SoC.
requirements.acceptance: <= 10 deg sun-pointing error, measured in TS-PFM-FUN

requirements.text: The ADCS shall provide a ground-target tracking mode that holds the payload boresight on a commanded geodetic target for at least 30 s.
requirements.rationale: Derived from F4.3 for night SWIR (modes.yaml already gives Night SWIR "target" pointing, but no requirement held it).
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: >= 30 s, measured in TS-PFM-FUN

requirements.text: The ADCS shall keep each reaction wheel below 80 % of its momentum capacity by magnetic desaturation during nominal operations.
requirements.rationale: Disturbance torques with deployed panels at 590 km are not yet assessed; margin for roll manoeuvres.
requirements.acceptance: <= 80 % wheel momentum capacity, shown by analysis in AN-PNT

requirements.text: The spacecraft residual magnetic dipole shall be at most 0.05 A m2 with all units in nominal mode.
requirements.rationale: Torquers give 0.2-0.3 A m2; residual dipole corrupts B-dot and desaturation.
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.05 A m2 residual dipole, measured in TS-PFM-MP

requirements.text: The ADCS shall provide its outputs (attitude estimate, body rates, mode, pointing error, wheel speeds and system momentum) to the on-board computer at 1 Hz in every mode except OFF.
requirements.rationale: These outputs are the routine ADCS SID and the per-frame attitude in the image metadata; raw sensor data goes to the separate diagnostic SID.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-EM-AOCS

requirements.text: The AOCS mass including the GNSS receiver, current best estimate plus maturity margin, shall not exceed its allocation of 0.65 kg.
requirements.rationale: Margined 0.62 kg; also covers the second-source iADCS200 (0.40-0.47 kg + GNSS).
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.65 kg, shown by analysis in AN-BUD

requirements.text: The AOCS orbit-average power including the GNSS receiver and maturity margin shall not exceed its allocation of 2.00 W.
requirements.rationale: Calculated 1.77 W, 1.92 W with maturity margin (the ADCS power is an estimate, category C 10 %).
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 2.0 W, shown by analysis in AN-BUD

requirements.text: The AOCS power including the GNSS receiver shall be at most 3.3 W in imaging mode.
requirements.rationale: Mode matrix 3.0 W (ADCS 1.6 + Sun 0.1 + GNSS 1.3) + 10 %.
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 3.3 W, measured in TS-EM-AOCS

requirements.text: During daytime acquisitions the line-of-sight angular rate shall be at most 0.1 deg/s (3 sigma).
requirements.rationale: Allocation of SYS-BUD-14: 0.1 deg/s gives 0.075 px of smear in 4.2 ms [Calculated]. Verified by closed-loop simulation with the supplier ADCS model (a CubeSat PFM cannot be tested for jitter on the ground); confirmed in commissioning.
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.1 deg/s, shown by analysis in AN-PNT

requirements.text: During night-SWIR exposures the line-of-sight rate relative to the tracked ground target shall be at most 0.05 deg/s (3 sigma).
requirements.rationale: Allocation of SYS-BUD-15: 0.05 deg/s gives 0.44 px in 50 ms [Calculated]. Verified by closed-loop simulation at CDR; confirmed in orbit on the first night campaign. The tracking pitch rate is about 0.67 deg/s; wheel momentum about 1.1 mNms against 1.42 mNms usable [Estimated: inertia 0.09 kg m2 with wings].
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.05 deg/s, shown by analysis in AN-PNT

requirements.text: The flight software shall implement PUS-C services 1, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9, 11, 12, 13, 15, 17 and 20 as tailored in the mission PUS tailoring document.
requirements.rationale: Verification, housekeeping, events, memory, functions, time, schedule, monitoring, large data transfer, storage, test, parameters.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-PFM-DITL

requirements.text: The flight software shall let each housekeeping SID be enabled, disabled and given a collection period from 1 s to 3600 s by telecommand.
requirements.rationale: Per-SID rates are the main tool for keeping real-time HK within the 4800 bit/s allocation.
requirements.acceptance: >= 1 s minimum SID period, measured in TS-EM-OBC

requirements.text: The default collection period of the thermal SID shall be 60 s.
requirements.rationale: Thermal time constants are minutes; faster sampling wastes downlink.
requirements.acceptance: == 60 s thermal SID period, confirmed by inspection in IN-EM-DHS

requirements.text: The ADCS routine SID shall contain only the ADCS outputs, with the ADCS raw-sensor and estimator data placed in a separate diagnostic SID that is disabled by default.
requirements.rationale: ADCS sends only its outputs routinely (SID 3, 560 bit/s at 1 s), with a separately enableable diagnostic SID 20 (1200 bit/s at 1 s) that an on-board procedure disables after a set duration.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-EM-OBC

requirements.text: The flight software shall provide separate packet stores for housekeeping, events and payload products, each with selectable downlink by store, time window and priority in every pass.
requirements.rationale: Operators choose per pass delayed HK, payload data or a mix.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-PFM-DITL

requirements.text: The on-board schedule shall hold at least 1000 time-tagged telecommands and execute each within 1 s of its release time.
requirements.rationale: 48 h of up to 14 roll targets per site per month, night-SWIR acquisitions and downlink set-up.
requirements.acceptance: >= 1000 time-tagged commands, measured in TS-EM-OBC

requirements.text: The flight software shall perform AES-256 authenticated encryption of telecommands and downlinked data independently of the radio.
requirements.rationale: Only one catalogue radio offers AES-256; doing it in the OBC keeps the radio choice open (trade T-07).
requirements.source_ref: research: bus §5 (encryption in OBC layer); CCSDS 355.0-B
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-PFM-DITL

requirements.text: The flight software shall accept in-orbit image updates verified by CRC before activation, and boot a protected golden image after 3 consecutive failed boots.
requirements.rationale: Student-written software will need patches; a bad patch must not lose the mission.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-PFM-DITL

requirements.text: A hardware watchdog shall reset the on-board computer within 60 s of a software hang.
requirements.rationale: Single-string OBC; the reset leads to Safe mode (SYS-MOD-02).
requirements.acceptance: <= 60 s to reset, measured in TS-PFM-DITL

requirements.text: On-board time shall be correlated to GNSS time to within 1 ms while a GNSS fix is available.
requirements.rationale: GNSS runs about 30 % of the time; time-tagged commands and pass predictions use on-board time between fixes.
requirements.acceptance: <= 1 ms, measured in TS-EM-OBC

requirements.text: Without a GNSS fix, on-board time shall drift by at most 1 s per day.
requirements.rationale: Holdover for housekeeping and the stored plan. This drift is far above the 1 ms frame time-tag budget, so payload acquisitions need a GNSS fix (GNS-OPS-02, OPS-PLN-02).
requirements.acceptance: <= 1 s/day, measured in TS-EM-OBC

requirements.text: The on-board computer mass, current best estimate plus maturity margin, shall not exceed its allocation of 0.05 kg.
requirements.rationale: Margined 0.025 kg.
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.05 kg, shown by analysis in AN-BUD

requirements.text: The on-board computer orbit-average power including maturity margin shall not exceed its allocation of 0.20 W.
requirements.rationale: Calculated 0.15 W, 0.16 W with maturity margin.
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.2 W, shown by analysis in AN-BUD

requirements.text: The stored housekeeping and event packets shall average at most 0.80 MB per day at the nominal storage periods.
requirements.rationale: Calculated 0.73 MB/day (NUMBERS telemetry) + 10 %.
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.8 MB/day, shown by analysis in AN-BUD

requirements.text: The downlink shall operate in 401-402 MHz outside 401.4-401.7 MHz at 38.4 kbps within an occupied bandwidth of at most 50 kHz.
requirements.rationale: Argos-type NGSO DCS sub-band avoided; a rate-1/2 convolutional code would need 80-104 kHz. 1 W RF nominal, 2 W where power allows.
requirements.source_ref: NFI brief; research: mission analysis R4, R5
requirements.acceptance: <= 50 kHz occupied bandwidth, measured in TS-PFM-E2E

requirements.text: The downlink shall use CCSDS TM synchronisation and channel coding with Reed-Solomon (255,223), attached sync marker and pseudo-randomisation.
requirements.rationale: RS(255,223) gives +4.0 dB at 1 W to a 300 K station where uncoded GMSK fails (research: mission analysis §3.2).
requirements.source_ref: CCSDS 131.0-B (TM synchronisation and channel coding); research: mission analysis §3.2
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-EM-COM

requirements.text: The radio shall support telecommand-selectable downlink rates of 1.2, 9.6, 19.2 and 38.4 kbps, with 76.8 kbps as a goal for passes above 30 deg elevation.
requirements.rationale: Rate ladder; 76.8 kbps closes above about 30 deg (35.7 min/day of the union) if the channel allows; a growth option only (licence change needed).
requirements.source_ref: research: mission analysis §3.4; design script §5.5 (rate ladder)
requirements.acceptance: >= 76.8 kbps goal above 30 deg, measured in TS-EM-COM

requirements.text: Spurious and out-of-band emissions of the transmitter shall meet ITU RR Appendix 3 and the ISED licence limits.
requirements.rationale: 401-402 MHz is shared with radiosondes and data-collection systems.
requirements.source_ref: ITU RR Appendix 3; ITU-R SM.329; ISED licence
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-PFM-E2E

requirements.text: The receiver shall demodulate telecommands in 449.75-450.25 MHz at 9.6 kbps with a bit-error rate of at most 1e-5 at the input level given by a 25 W ground transmitter at 10 deg elevation minus 3 dB.
requirements.rationale: Uplink margin +10 to +14 dB at 25 W; the 450.25 MHz upper receive edge of the selected transceiver is still to be confirmed by the vendor.
requirements.source_ref: NFI brief; research: mission analysis §3.3; ITU RR 5.286
requirements.acceptance: >= 9.6 kbps, measured in TS-PFM-E2E

requirements.text: The telecommand receiver shall be powered in every mode except OFF/launch and after passivation.
requirements.rationale: The spacecraft must always be commandable, including in Safe and Survival.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-PFM-E2E

requirements.text: The UHF antenna system shall provide one element tuned to 401.5 MHz for transmit and one tuned to 450 MHz for receive, each with gain at least -3 dBi toward the ground station at 10 deg elevation in nominal attitude.
requirements.rationale: 401.5 and 450 MHz are 48 MHz apart against >10 MHz element bandwidth; -3 dBi is the link-budget allowance.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-EM-COM

requirements.text: Each antenna element shall deploy through two redundant release heaters and report its deployed state by a switch.
requirements.rationale: Antenna deployment is a single point of failure for the mission.
requirements.source_ref: research: bus §5b (AntS burn wire, redundant heaters)
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-PFM-E2E

requirements.text: In LEOP, Safe and Survival the spacecraft shall transmit a beacon frame with the essential housekeeping SID at 1.2 kbps at least every 60 s on the licensed downlink channel.
requirements.rationale: First acquisition and anomaly diagnosis; content and encryption to agree with GAC (SYS-SEC-02).
requirements.acceptance: <= 60 s beacon interval, measured in TS-PFM-E2E

requirements.text: The communications mass, current best estimate plus maturity margin, shall not exceed its allocation of 0.20 kg.
requirements.rationale: Margined 0.15 kg; the allocation holds room for the AX100UL + R0405 fallback (RSK-010).
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.2 kg, shown by analysis in AN-BUD

requirements.text: The communications orbit-average power including maturity margin shall not exceed its allocation of 0.50 W.
requirements.rationale: Calculated 0.43 W (receiver always on, transmitter 9 % of the orbit), 0.46 W with maturity margin (transmitter DC power estimated, 10 %).
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.5 W, shown by analysis in AN-BUD

requirements.text: The radio DC power while transmitting at 1 W RF shall be at most 3.6 W.
requirements.rationale: Mode matrix 3.3 W (estimate) + 10 %; RSK-010 radio choice.
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 3.6 W, measured in TS-EM-COM

requirements.text: The structure shall meet the CDS rev 14.1 3U envelope of 100 x 100 x 340.5 mm with hard-anodised rails at least 8.5 mm wide and no protrusion beyond 6.5 mm from the rail plane.
requirements.rationale: Deployer fit; stowed antennas, sail and wings count against the protrusion envelope.
requirements.acceptance: <= 6.5 mm protrusion, confirmed by inspection in IN-PFM-STR

requirements.text: The centre of mass shall lie within 20 mm of the geometric centre in X and Y and within 70 mm in Z.
requirements.rationale: CDS rev 14.1 3U limits; the 1U payload and battery at one end push the CoG along Z.
requirements.threshold_unit: mm CoG offset in X and Y
requirements.acceptance: <= 20 mm CoG offset in X and Y, measured in TS-PFM-MP

requirements.text: The first natural frequency of the spacecraft in the deployer shall be at least 100 Hz (TBC against the launch ICD).
requirements.rationale: Decouples from launcher modes; confirmed by sine survey (VER-ENV-01).
requirements.acceptance: >= 100 Hz first mode (TBC), shown by analysis in AN-STR
requirements.open_item_note: open item carried from v1; TBC in text

requirements.text: The structure shall have positive margins with factors of safety of at least 1.25 on yield and 1.4 on ultimate under launch loads.
requirements.rationale: Test-verified structure factors.
requirements.acceptance: >= 1.25 yield factor of safety, shown by analysis in AN-STR

requirements.text: The configuration shall keep the -Z face clear for the payload apertures, give the star tracker a 42 deg field of view with 30 deg Sun exclusion, give the GNSS antenna a zenith view and give the drag sail an unobstructed deployment path.
requirements.rationale: The +Z face is contested by the antenna, sail, star tracker and GNSS patch; resolution in LB-21.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, confirmed by review in RV-PDR-STR

requirements.text: The payload bench shall keep the relative boresight of the two cameras within 0.5 SWIR pixel (49 urad) between ground calibration and orbit, after launch vibration and over 0-25 degC.
requirements.rationale: Allocates half of the 1 SWIR pixel band-to-band budget to the bench; the rest goes to the map and resampling.
requirements.source_ref: NFI brief (one rigid bench); research: payload §7
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.5 SWIR px boresight change, measured in TS-PFM-VIB

requirements.text: Every spring-driven deployment mechanism (antennas, solar wings, drag sail) shall have a motorisation factor of at least 2 at end of life.
requirements.rationale: Deployment reliability after 3 years stowed.
requirements.acceptance: >= 2 motorisation factor, shown by analysis in AN-STR

requirements.text: The structure mass, current best estimate plus maturity margin, shall not exceed its allocation of 0.45 kg.
requirements.rationale: Margined 0.40 kg.
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.45 kg, shown by analysis in AN-BUD

requirements.text: The SWIR camera shall be kept between 0 and 25 degC during imaging.
requirements.rationale: DSNU and dark current; housing rated -20 to +55 degC (research: payload §1.1).
requirements.acceptance: <= 25 degC SWIR camera during imaging, shown by analysis in AN-THM

requirements.text: Every unit shall stay within its operating limits, with a 10 degC uncertainty margin at PDR, for beta angles from 14 to 29 deg and daylight-node times from 09:30 to 13:30 in the hot (imaging and downlink in sunlight) and cold (Safe in eclipse) cases.
requirements.rationale: Beta range for the 09:30-13:30 node window; no mission thermal model exists yet.
requirements.acceptance: >= 10 degC uncertainty margin, shown by analysis in AN-THM

requirements.text: The SWIR camera shall be kept between -20 and +55 degC at all times.
requirements.rationale: Split from THM-PAY-01 (one measurable 'shall' per requirement). DSNU and dark current; housing rated -20 to +55 degC (research: payload §1.1).
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, shown by analysis in AN-THM

requirements.text: The temperature difference between the two camera mounts on the payload bench shall be at most 2 degC during imaging.
requirements.rationale: Limits thermo-elastic boresight change between the bands.
requirements.acceptance: <= 2 degC between camera mounts, shown by analysis in AN-THM

requirements.text: The thermal-control mass, current best estimate plus maturity margin, shall not exceed its allocation of 0.15 kg.
requirements.rationale: Margined 0.11 kg; heaters and MLI are not yet sized by a thermal model.
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.15 kg, shown by analysis in AN-BUD

requirements.text: The heater orbit-average power in the nominal operations mix shall not exceed its allocation of 0.10 W.
requirements.rationale: The mode matrix has no bench-heater duty in the nominal mix; 0.10 W is held until the thermal model confirms it (THM-ALL-01).
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.1 W, shown by analysis in AN-BUD

requirements.text: The battery shall be kept between 0 and +40 degC in every mode.
requirements.rationale: Thermal ledger. [ASSUMPTION: BP4 operating range; verify the datasheet limits.] The lower bound repeats the charging limit of EPS-THM-01.
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: within 0 to 40 degC, shown by analysis in AN-THM

requirements.text: The payload controller shall be kept between -20 and +70 degC during an imaging session.
requirements.rationale: Thermal ledger: the controller dissipates up to 5 W for about 5 min per orbit. [ASSUMPTION: carrier and module limits; verify on the breadboard.]
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: within -20 to 70 degC, shown by analysis in AN-THM

requirements.text: The drag sail shall deploy to an area of at least 2.0 m2.
requirements.rationale: ARTICA is 0.35U and up to 2.1 m2; configuration A is rated for 2 years, so the timer battery is team-built.
requirements.acceptance: >= 2.0 m2, confirmed by inspection in IN-EM-DEB

requirements.text: The drag sail shall remain deployable after 6 months in the deployer followed by 3.5 years in orbit.
requirements.rationale: ARTICA configuration A is rated for 2 years (research: mission analysis §2.3); a long-storage variant or rating evidence is needed (RSK-002).
requirements.acceptance: >= 3.5 years in orbit, shown by analysis in AN-DEB

requirements.text: The disposal subsystem mass (drag sail plus independent timer and battery), current best estimate plus maturity margin, shall not exceed its allocation of 0.42 kg.
requirements.rationale: Margined 0.41 kg [Calculated]: v1 carried 0.40 kg, which the 20 % maturity margin on the new timer exceeds.
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.42 kg, shown by analysis in AN-BUD

requirements.text: The stowed drag-sail unit including its own trigger electronics shall have a mass of at most 0.32 kg.
requirements.rationale: Unit-level share of DIS-BUD-01: configuration A is 0.30 kg (research: bus §7) plus 5 % maturity.
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.32 kg, measured in TS-PFM-DEP

requirements.text: The stowed drag sail including its own trigger electronics shall occupy at most 0.35U.
requirements.rationale: Split from DIS-SAIL-01 (one measurable 'shall' per requirement). ARTICA is 0.35U and up to 2.1 m2; configuration A is rated for 2 years, so the timer battery is team-built.
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.35 U, confirmed by inspection in IN-EM-DEB

requirements.text: The drag sail shall deploy on an authenticated ARM and FIRE ground command, on expiry of an independent timer after 90 days without a valid telecommand, or on battery under-voltage.
requirements.rationale: 90 days is the team choice (TBC with ISED); it bounds the delay after an unrecoverable anomaly.
requirements.acceptance: <= 90 days without valid TC, measured in TS-PFM-DEP

requirements.text: The sail shall have two independent release circuits, each able to deploy the sail alone, one powered by the EPS and one by the independent disposal battery.
requirements.rationale: No single failure prevents deployment (SYS-REL-01).
requirements.acceptance: >= 2 independent release circuits, measured in TS-PFM-DEP

requirements.text: The disposal timer and its battery shall operate with no power, clock or software from the on-board computer or the EPS.
requirements.rationale: The timer must fire after a total OBC or EPS failure.
requirements.source_ref: NFI brief (own timer and battery, independent of OBC)
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-PFM-DEP

requirements.text: The independent disposal battery shall hold enough energy for at least 2 full release actuations after 3.5 years including its timer consumption.
requirements.rationale: ARTICA needs about 6 W for seconds; two attempts plus the timer quiescent current.
requirements.acceptance: >= 2 release actuations at 3.5 y, shown by analysis in AN-DEB

requirements.text: The disposal timer shall be restarted only by a pulse generated on receipt of an authenticated telecommand.
requirements.rationale: A software fault that keeps resetting the timer would defeat it; only a valid command proves the satellite is under control.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-PFM-DEP

requirements.text: The disposal subsystem shall report timer count, battery voltage, arming state and sail-deployed switch states in the disposal SID.
requirements.rationale: Confirmation before passivation, then by decay rate from tracking data.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-PFM-DEP

requirements.text: The disposal subsystem standby power drawn from the EPS shall not exceed its allocation of 0.01 W.
requirements.rationale: The independent timer runs from its own battery (DIS-IND-01); only status sensing loads the EPS.
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.01 W, shown by analysis in AN-BUD

requirements.text: Each sail release actuation shall draw at most 6.5 W for at most 60 s.
requirements.rationale: ARTICA actuation 6 W for seconds (KB); sizes release circuit A on the EPS and the independent battery (DIS-BAT-01).
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 6.5 W, measured in TS-EM-DIS

requirements.text: Every wire and connector contact shall be derated in current according to ECSS-Q-ST-30-11C for its gauge and bundle size.
requirements.rationale: Student-built harness; derating is the main workmanship safeguard.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, shown by analysis in AN-HAR

requirements.text: The two sail release circuits shall use separate connectors and separate routing from each other and from the EPS distribution harness.
requirements.rationale: A connector or chafe failure must not take out both circuits.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, confirmed by inspection in IN-EM-HAR

requirements.text: The GNSS receiver shall provide position within 20 m and velocity within 0.1 m/s (3 sigma) in orbit.
requirements.rationale: Orbit determination for conjunction screening and image geolocation; NanoSense (OEM719) gives 1.5 m.
requirements.acceptance: <= 20 m position (3 sigma), measured in TS-EM-AOCS

requirements.text: The GNSS receiver shall deliver a PPS aligned to GPS time within 1 us to both the on-board computer and the payload controller.
requirements.rationale: OEM719 PPS is 20 ns RMS; wiring to the payload controller is a recommendation of the bus research.
requirements.acceptance: <= 1 us PPS error, measured in TS-EM-AOCS

requirements.text: The GNSS receiver shall track at orbital velocity and altitude, with COCOM limits removed under an export authorisation.
requirements.rationale: Terrestrial receivers stop above 18 km altitude or 515 m/s.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-EM-AOCS

requirements.text: The GNSS receiver shall deliver a valid PPS within 90 s of power-on from a warm start.
requirements.rationale: Derived: the receiver is duty-cycled (30 % in nominal mode) but every frame needs a GNSS-locked time-tag. [ASSUMPTION: 90 s warm time to fix for the OEM719 class; verify.]
requirements.source_ref: v2 SE pass: functional architecture and budget flow-down
requirements.acceptance: <= 90 s, measured in TS-EM-AOCS

requirements.text: The on-board orbit propagator shall predict position within 2 km after 48 h without a GNSS fix.
requirements.rationale: Target pointing and pass predictions in the stored plan run between GNSS fixes (GNSS duty about 30 %).
requirements.acceptance: <= 2 km after 48 h, shown by analysis in AN-PNT

requirements.text: The payload controller shall exchange commands, status and product files with the on-board computer over the CAN bus at a sustained file-transfer rate of at least 100 kbit/s.
requirements.rationale: Products stay on the payload store until the pass; 100 kbit/s keeps the 38.4 kbps downlink fed with margin.
requirements.acceptance: >= 100 kbit/s sustained file transfer, measured in TS-EM-PAY

requirements.text: The payload controller shall connect the VNIR camera on a 4-lane and the SWIR camera on a 2- or 4-lane MIPI CSI-2 port and trigger both cameras with a skew of at most 100 us.
requirements.rationale: 100 us is 0.7 m along track; the IMX542 needs the 4-lane port (research: payload §4).
requirements.acceptance: <= 100 us trigger skew, measured in TS-EM-PAY

requirements.text: The ADCS shall accept time-tagged attitude-target commands (nadir, roll target, inertial, sun) and orbit data at 1 Hz from the on-board computer.
requirements.rationale: The ADCS needs position for nadir and target pointing; profiles come from the stored plan.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-EM-AOCS

requirements.text: The GNSS receiver shall send position, velocity and time records at 1 Hz to the on-board computer over a UART while it is powered.
requirements.rationale: The OBC forwards them to the ADCS and the payload controller and uses them for time correlation.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-EM-AOCS

requirements.text: The EPS shall supply each unit on its own switched line at 3.3 V or 5 V within ±5 % or at battery voltage (12-16.8 V), with the line current limit set by the electrical ICD.
requirements.rationale: Line list and LCL settings are in the Electrical tab (design script §5.1); each unit's ICD sheet states its inrush and peak current.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-EM-EPS

requirements.text: The radio shall exchange complete, already encrypted transfer frames with the on-board computer and report RSSI, frequency offset and frame counters for each pass.
requirements.rationale: Keeps encryption in the OBC so the radio is replaceable (trade T-07).
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-EM-COM

requirements.text: The disposal interface shall provide release circuit A from an EPS switched battery line rated at least 2 A, release circuit B from the independent disposal battery, the timer-restart pulse from the on-board computer and the deployed-state switches to both the on-board computer and the timer.
requirements.rationale: Circuit B is outside the EPS; the timer reads the deployed state so it stops firing after deployment.
requirements.source_ref: NFI brief; research: bus §7; design script §5.1 (release A/B)
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-EM-DIS

requirements.text: The spacecraft-to-deployer interface (rail contact, deployment-switch positions, access port and remove-before-flight pin location) shall be agreed with the launch provider in an ICD before CDR.
requirements.rationale: The deployer type is not yet known; switch positions and access windows differ between deployers.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, confirmed by review in RV-CDR-ICD

requirements.text: Space-to-ground data shall use CCSDS TM and TC space data link protocols with SDLS security, CCSDS space packets carrying PUS-C services, and file delivery with acknowledged retransmission of missing segments for payload products.
requirements.rationale: Standard stack shared by the MCS and the simulator; CSP may still run on the internal CAN bus. File retransmission recovers frames lost at low elevation.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-PFM-E2E

requirements.text: Each ground station shall acquire the downlink within 30 s of rising above 10 deg elevation for Doppler offsets up to ±10 kHz.
requirements.rationale: The data budget assumes 30 s acquisition per pass; Doppler at 401 MHz from 590 km is about ±9.5 kHz.
requirements.source_ref: research: mission analysis §3.4 (30 s acquisition per pass)
requirements.acceptance: <= 30 s acquisition time, measured in TS-EM-SYS

requirements.text: Each ground station shall forward received TM frames to mission control and transmit TC frames from it with at most 2 s latency, and accept schedules and report station status over the VPN.
requirements.rationale: Real-time commanding through remote stations; schedules are pushed at least 24 h ahead (SEG-GS-09).
requirements.source_ref: NFI brief (mission control with VPN to remote sites)
requirements.acceptance: <= 2 s frame forwarding latency, measured in TS-GS-ACC

requirements.text: Mission control shall deliver to the science segment, for each acquisition, the payload files, the attitude and GNSS records from 60 s before to 60 s after it, and the current time-correlation data.
requirements.rationale: Everything Level-1 processing needs, in one package.
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in TS-GS-ACC

risk_register.description: The 449.75-450.25 MHz uplink needs an RR 9.21 agreement and sits next to radiolocation (438-450 MHz) and heavily used land-mobile (450-470 MHz) bands; coordination may be slow or refused.
risk_register.mitigation: Start ISED pre-consultation now; keep the 148-149.9 MHz VHF uplink fallback qualified; use the lowest uplink power that closes (<= 25 W); ask ISED/DND about 420-450 MHz radar interference.
risk_register.source: NFI brief: UHF 450 MHz uplink coordination; research: mission analysis R6

risk_register.description: Disposal compliance (re-entry <= 5 years, >= 90 % probability) depends on the drag sail deploying; ARTICA has no published deployment result, its self-powered configuration is rated 2 years, and without the sail re-entry takes 14-42 years.
risk_register.mitigation: OBC-independent timer and battery with two release circuits; ask NPC for FUTURA SM1 deployment telemetry and a long-storage variant; ground deployment tests after TVAC; HPS ADEO-P as fallback; DRAMA/DAS at PDR.
risk_register.source: NFI brief: drag-sail deployment reliability; research: mission analysis R8, bus R4

risk_register.description: The payload peak is about 11.5 W (cameras 2.7 + 3.8 W, controller 3-5 W), budgeted as 12 W; body-mounted panels give about 4.0 W EOL at beta 15 deg against a 5.0 W need with margin.
risk_register.mitigation: Keep deployable wings as baseline (about 12.2 W EOL orbit average); budget the payload at 12 W peak; switch the controller off between sessions.
risk_register.source: NFI brief: payload peak power vs power budget; research: payload §3.7

risk_register.description: Water SNR at the native SWIR resolution is marginal in October (about 10 at f/1.8) and fails in November; the IMX542 has only about 15 % QE at 865 nm.
risk_register.mitigation: f/1.4 SWIR lens; VNIR always binned to the 60 m grid; SWIR 2x2 binning or high-conversion-gain mode for late-season water scenes; check SNR at 15 deg sun elevation.
risk_register.source: NFI brief: SWIR SNR over dark targets; research: payload §3.4

risk_register.description: Thermal or launch-induced shifts between the two cameras could exceed the 1 SWIR pixel registration requirement.
risk_register.mitigation: One rigid bench with thermal straps; boresight map measured on the ground and updated in orbit over invariant sites; single-camera two-zone-filter option kept as a PDR trade.

risk_register.description: Long-lead items (ADCS about 17 weeks, radio receive band still to be confirmed by the vendor, SWIR camera subject to an export licence) could delay the engineering model.
risk_register.mitigation: Place ADCS and camera orders after MCR; request radio quotes and the 450.25 MHz receive confirmation now; obtain the camera ECCN before the breadboard order.

risk_register.description: The secondary slot does not guarantee the local time; an inclination error drifts the node by about 18 min per year per 0.1 deg.
risk_register.mitigation: Specify inclination tolerance <= 0.15 deg in the launch request; size power and thermal for node times 09:30-13:30.
risk_register.source: NFI brief: LTAN not guaranteed; research: mission analysis R14

risk_register.description: The four-site network (125.7 min/day union, 25.3 MB/day capacity) closes the 13 MB/day post-compression target with 38 % margin, but the planned product set (16.7 MB raw) fits only with >= 1.28:1 lossless compression, which is unverified on mission scenes, and at the 19.2 kbps fallback rate the budget fails by 23 %.
risk_register.mitigation: Verify CCSDS 121 on simulated scenes before CDR (goal 1.5:1); at 19.2 kbps cut ROIs to 60 per day (about 9 MB/day); per-pass HK profiles (LEAN on dump passes); 76.8 kbps above 30 deg (35.7 min/day) as a growth option.
risk_register.source: NFI brief: limited UHF bandwidth; calc/budget_nfi.py (NUMBERS.yaml data_budget)

risk_register.description: 0.1 deg knowledge needs a star tracker, which makes the ADCS the largest single cost (about 53.5 k EUR list build, 23 % of flight hardware); the Gen 1 'CubeADCS 3-Axis Small' configuration may be obsolete by 2027-2030.
risk_register.mitigation: Quote the Gen 2 build with CubeStar and CubeSense Sun; AAC iADCS200 as second source; keep the cost estimate on list prices until quotes arrive.
risk_register.source: NFI brief: ADCS pointing adequacy; research: bus R2, R3

risk_register.description: No catalogue transceiver is confirmed for a 401 MHz 38.4 kbps downlink plus a 449.75-450.25 MHz uplink in one unit; the selected Murgas lists receive to 450 MHz, so the 450.25 MHz edge is unconfirmed.
risk_register.mitigation: Ask Spacemanic to confirm a 449.75-450.25 MHz receive setting; quote AAC TRX-U at 38.4 kbps; fallback GomSpace AX100UL plus an STT R0405 450 MHz receiver.

risk_register.description: With a 1 W radio, the downlink margin at 10 deg is only +0.4 dB at an urban site (700 K) with RS coding, and negative uncoded; the Ottawa station is the only site at risk (the three northern sites are rural, +4.0 dB).
risk_register.mitigation: RS(255,223) coding; site the Ottawa antenna outside the urban core after a noise survey (<= 300 K gives +4.0 dB, +6.0 dB with the 15 dBic Yagi); 2 W if the radio allows.

risk_register.description: If the injected apogee exceeds 600 km, the ISED April 2026 conditions require active propulsion, which the spacecraft does not have.
risk_register.mitigation: Request apogee <= 590 km including dispersion; confirm the wording of the N2 annex with ISED.

risk_register.description: The InGaAs SWIR camera is very likely a dual-use item (6A003); permits are needed for import and for export to the launch site.
risk_register.mitigation: Written ECCN from the vendor before the breadboard order; permits planned at EM (month ~12) and L-6 months.

risk_register.description: No radiation data exist for the Alvium cameras, the IMX992 or the IMX542; InGaAs hot pixels grow in orbit.
risk_register.mitigation: Switched current-limited supplies with latch-up detection; power cycling; dark frames every pass; hot-pixel map updates; optional proton screening.

risk_register.description: Depth of focus is only ±6-14 um, comparable to the air-to-vacuum and thermal focus shifts of C-mount lenses.
risk_register.mitigation: Focus against a collimator in vacuum (or with a measured offset); stake focus and iris; vent and bake out the lenses.

risk_register.description: Volume is tight and the +Z face is wanted by the UHF antenna, the 0.35U drag sail, the star tracker field of view and the GNSS patch.
risk_register.mitigation: BP4 instead of BPX (+18 mm); antennas in the wings or on a side face; star tracker off a long face; keep +Z for the sail.

risk_register.description: Night detection of overwintering fires is marginal: a 10 m2 hotspot at 800 K gives about 7 % of a daytime signal and fires under snow are invisible.
risk_register.mitigation: Frame O2 as an exploratory test with a reportable null result; long-exposure and dark-frame mode; compare with VIIRS and Landsat night detections.

risk_register.description: 401-402 MHz is shared with radiosondes and data-collection systems (Argos, GOES DCS); interference both ways is possible.
risk_register.mitigation: Choose the channel with ISED early, outside 401.4-401.7 MHz; check upper-air stations near the receive sites.

risk_register.description: The mainline Alvium CSI-2 driver has not been demonstrated on the Raspberry Pi camera front-end used by the payload controller.
risk_register.mitigation: Breadboard both cameras on the controller in months 1-3; Jetson-class or Xiphos fallback recorded in the controller trade.

risk_register.description: The mission burn index is NDMI-like (865 nm and ~1.6 um) with about half the dynamic range of dNBR, so the 0.08 bias target is relatively tight; a 1550 nm filter would also need a spectral band adjustment against S2 B11.
risk_register.mitigation: Centre the SWIR filter at about 1610 nm; validate against dNBR from Landsat/S2 and report severity classes.

risk_register.description: The VNIR camera saturates on fresh snow at f/2.4 with a 2.3 ms exposure in June.
risk_register.mitigation: Seasonal exposure table (about 1-1.5 ms over snow in spring).

risk_register.description: The 1.77 mNms wheels may saturate under aerodynamic and gravity-gradient torques once the deployable wings are added.
risk_register.mitigation: Disturbance-torque analysis with the wing geometry at PDR; magnetorquer desaturation each orbit.

risk_register.description: Three of the four stations are unattended northern sites (Yellowknife, Iqaluit, Inuvik) with -45 degC winters, ice loading, polar night, power and network outages and slow physical access; a site can be out for weeks.
risk_register.mitigation: Heated heavy-duty rotator housings and a short-Yagi winter spare; remote power cycling and site monitoring over the VPN; spares at each site and a local service arrangement; the network tolerates any single site out (worst case Inuvik: 93.4 min/day, budget margin +17.6 %).

risk_register.description: Because the v1 payload (0.70 kg) and disposal (0.40 kg) caps held no maturity margin, the margined masses (0.748 and 0.411 kg) already exceed them, so any growth would breach a requirement at PDR.
risk_register.mitigation: Allocations re-set with maturity margins (PAY-BUD-01 0.76 kg, DIS-BUD-01 0.42 kg); system closure 5.32 kg <= 6.0 kg; trend the margin monthly.

risk_register.description: Because a 50 ms night exposure moves 5.9 SWIR pixels over the ground, night images taken in nadir or roll pointing smear a sub-pixel hotspot; O2 could then report a null result for an instrumental reason.
risk_register.mitigation: Ground-target tracking mode (ADC-MOD-03) with residual <= 0.05 deg/s (ADC-STB-02); confirm the CubeADCS target-tracking mode and test it on the EM with the simulator; momentum check 1.1 of 1.42 mNms.

risk_register.description: Because the GNSS receiver is duty-cycled and on-board holdover drifts up to 1 s/day, an acquisition started without a fix would carry a time-tag error far above 1 ms, degrading geolocation and pre-registration.
risk_register.mitigation: GNS-OPS-02 (PPS within 90 s of power-on) and flight rule OPS-PLN-02 (GNSS on >= 120 s before each acquisition); frames without a valid fix flagged in L0.

risk_register.description: Because site communities may include First Nations, Inuit or Metis communities and v1 released all products openly by default, the mission could release data about community lands against their data-governance terms, or proceed without a documented consent and agreement process; the community could withdraw and O3 would lose its sites.
risk_register.mitigation: Site agreements with data-governance annexes before CDR (MIS-IF-06, MIS-SCI-14); open release made conditional (MIS-DAT-05); community engagement scheduled on community timelines, not gate dates; legal applicability checked with counsel [Uncertain].
risk_register.source: v2 stakeholder and validation pass (SE skill proactive triggers: community / Indigenous context, data sovereignty)

risk_register.description: Because rideshare manifests slip and change provider, the spacecraft may need a different deployer or slot, delaying launch by 3-12 months.
risk_register.mitigation: Compatibility with two deployer designs (MIS-IF-01); 550-600 km acceptance range (ECP-02); keep backup approach B of T-M02 quoted.

risk_register.description: Because several student sub-teams define interfaces in parallel, units, packet layouts or connector pin-outs may drift between them, causing integration failures (cf. Mars Climate Orbiter).
risk_register.mitigation: One mission database (SYS-IF-14), SI units (SYS-IF-15), interface standards SYS-IF-01..13 at SRR, ICDs at Issue A by PDR under configuration control.
risk_register.source: v2 internal interface standards (SE skill: interface management)

risk_register.description: Because the 36-month development spans several student cohorts, design knowledge and rationale may be lost at each handover.
risk_register.mitigation: Decision records and trade records in the logbook; configuration baselines at SRR, PDR and CDR; handover review at each term change; seat owners named per requirement.
risk_register.source: SE skill proactive trigger (team handover points)

risk_register.description: Because products are verified against requirements written by engineers, they may meet every requirement and still not help the communities (wrong format, timing or language).
risk_register.mitigation: Needs validation before PRR (MIS-VAL-01), simulated products reviewed by communities before AR (MIS-VAL-03), seasonal assessments (SEG-US-10).
risk_register.source: v2 validation thread (vv_plan V1, V3, V6)

risk_register.description: Because the DMSA wing mass, the radio transmit power and the ADCS power are estimates without supplier datasheet values, the budgets may grow when the datasheets arrive.
risk_register.mitigation: Category C (10 %) margins on these values until datasheets arrive; request DMSA datasheet and radio power figures before PDR.

risk_register.description: Because the independent disposal timer and battery is a new unit at TRL 4 and the only path to compliance when the OBC is lost, a late maturation would put licensing and launch at risk.
risk_register.mitigation: Breadboard at month 6, EM accelerated-timer test and TVAC to reach TRL 6 before CDR; long-life battery chemistry chosen by analysis (DIS-BAT-01).

risk_register.description: Because the 0.275 MEUR estimate covers flight and ground hardware only (no launch, AIT facilities, labour, licence fees or reserve) and no reference-class forecast has been made, the mission cost may be well above the 0.8 MEUR target without anyone noticing before PDR.
risk_register.mitigation: Price launch (T-M02 quotes) and AIT; apply a reference class of university CubeSat outturn costs; hold a management reserve; report MDR-EC-08 as open until then.
risk_register.source: SE skill proactive trigger (optimism bias); budgets.yaml cost

risk_register.description: Because trade T-A01 recommends two IMX992 cameras (ECP-01) but the baseline keeps the IMX542 VNIR camera, the payload design may change at PDR; adopting ECP-01 needs a custom NIR filter blocking to 1700 nm and short exposures over snow.
risk_register.mitigation: Quote the NIR filter and measure IMX992 NIR response and minimum exposure on the breadboard before PDR; decide ECP-01 at PDR.

risk_register.description: Because the pre-registration geolocation at 30 deg roll is 1.37 km (3 sigma) against 1.5 km, a degraded star-tracker alignment would push large-roll scenes outside the registration search window.
risk_register.mitigation: In-orbit alignment calibration (ADC-PNT-03); registration search window sized for 2 km; flag large-roll scenes.

risk_register.description: Because the payload transfers files over the same CAN bus that carries TM to the radio, an unbounded transfer rate could exceed 50 % bus load during passes and delay telemetry.
risk_register.mitigation: Transfer rate limited to 100-169 kbit/s while downlinking (SYS-IF-04, IF-PAY-OBC-01); transfers scheduled outside passes when possible.

mission_need.problem_statement: Northern communities face two seasonal hazards that are poorly observed at the scale they need: wildfire (burn scars, post-fire recovery and fires that overwinter in peat) and river and lake ice (freeze-up and break-up timing, ice roads, spring ice-jam flooding). Free Sentinel-2 and Landsat data exist but cannot be tasked by the communities, do not image at night, and do not show whether a low-cost student-built instrument can reproduce these landscape-scale measurements within known limits. Northern Fire and Ice is a 3U CubeSat with a near-infrared (865 nm) and short-wave infrared (1610 nm) imager at about 60 m that tests this, at sites chosen with the communities, with every product calibrated against Sentinel-2 and Landsat.
mission_need.operational_context: Sun-synchronous orbit at 590 km (apogee <= 600 km), daylight descending node 10:30 (window 09:30-13:30), rideshare launch from a 3U deployer around mid-2030 after a 36-month development. Four UHF ground stations at generic sites near Ottawa, Yellowknife, Iqaluit and Inuvik give about 126 min of contact per day (union, 10 deg mask); mission control in Ottawa. Landscape-scale, seasonal monitoring, not emergency response; not designed for active-fire detection, fire radiative power, smoke, or ice thickness. Licensing under ISED (space and earth stations, April 2026 debris conditions), ITU, and the RSSSA.

objectives.text: Map burn scars and relative burn severity of boreal fires at landscape scale.
objectives.measurable_criterion: >= 40 usable cloud-free scene pairs over >= 3 burns in the first year; burn-index bias vs the dNBR-calibrated reference within 0.08

objectives.text: Explore, as an exploratory test, whether overwintering fires can be detected with SWIR at night and in early spring.
objectives.measurable_criterion: >= 10 night SWIR images over each of >= 2 previous-season burns (1 Mar - 31 May); detection or documented null result

objectives.text: Measure river- and lake-ice phenology (freeze-up, break-up, ice-on, ice-off) at community-selected sites.
objectives.measurable_criterion: one complete break-up season at >= 3 community-selected sites; ice extent for channels wider than 175 m

objectives.text: Quantify how well a low-cost student instrument reproduces Sentinel-2 and Landsat measurements and publish the uncertainty.
objectives.measurable_criterion: radiometric repeatability <= 5 %; geolocation <= 2 px after registration; >= 20 same-day matchups per product type per year; uncertainty published

objectives.text: Comply with ISED spectrum and debris conditions, the RSSSA licence, ITU procedures and export control.
objectives.measurable_criterion: all licences granted before launch; re-entry <= 5 years after end of operations with >= 90 % probability; collision probability < 0.001

success_criteria: Map burn scars and relative burn severity of boreal fires at landscape scale: >= 40 usable cloud-free scene pairs over >= 3 burns in year 1; burn-index bias within 0.08 of the dNBR-calibrated reference

Measure river- and lake-ice phenology (freeze-up, break-up, ice-on, ice-off) at community-selected sites: one complete break-up season at >= 3 community-selected sites; ice extent for channels wider than 175 m

Quantify how well a low-cost student instrument reproduces Sentinel-2 and Landsat measurements and publish the uncertainty: repeatability <= 5 %; geolocation <= 2 px after registration; >= 20 matchups per product type per year
mission_need.selection_rationale: Sentinel-2 and Landsat are free and remain the reference for every product, but they cannot be tasked by the communities, acquire no night SWIR (exploratory objective O2) and cannot answer the central question (O4) of whether a low-cost student-built instrument reproduces their measurements. Drones and aircraft do not cover landscape scale (150 km swath) through the break-up season at remote sites, and ground sensors give points, not ice extent. A dedicated 3U CubeSat meets O1-O4 within a student-programme envelope and is the training vehicle the sponsor funds; the free missions are used for cross-calibration and validation rather than replaced.
mission_need.conops_summary: LEOP (B-dot detumble, antenna and wing deployment, first contacts) for about 7 days, platform commissioning to day 30 and payload commissioning to day 90 (dark frames, first light, boresight map, cross-calibration with Sentinel-2/Landsat, roll tests, compression check). Nominal operations: nadir standby with scheduled acquisitions of a few minutes per orbit over burns (Jun-Sep), freeze-up (Oct-Dec), break-up (Apr-Jun) and exploratory night SWIR over previous burns (Mar-May), rolling up to ±30 deg for revisit; quicklooks and region-of-interest pairs, losslessly compressed, returned at 38.4 kbps over four UHF stations (about 126 min/day union, 14 windows, 13 MB/day of compressed products); per pass the operators choose delayed housekeeping or payload data. Safe and survival modes on faults or low battery; a stored plan covers 48 h without contact. End of life: drag sail deployed by command, by an OBC-independent 90-day timer or on under-voltage; transmitters off and battery passivated; re-entry about 3.0-3.4 years later from 590 km.

requirements.text: The mission shall map burn scars and relative burn severity of boreal fires at landscape scale.
requirements.rationale: >= 40 usable cloud-free scene pairs over >= 3 burns in the first year; burn-index bias vs the dNBR-calibrated reference within 0.08

requirements.text: The mission shall explore, as an exploratory test, whether overwintering fires can be detected with SWIR at night and in early spring.
requirements.rationale: >= 10 night SWIR images over each of >= 2 previous-season burns (1 Mar - 31 May); detection or documented null result

requirements.text: The mission shall measure river- and lake-ice phenology (freeze-up, break-up, ice-on, ice-off) at community-selected sites.
requirements.rationale: one complete break-up season at >= 3 community-selected sites; ice extent for channels wider than 175 m

requirements.text: The mission shall quantify how well a low-cost student instrument reproduces Sentinel-2 and Landsat measurements and publish the uncertainty.
requirements.rationale: radiometric repeatability <= 5 %; geolocation <= 2 px after registration; >= 20 same-day matchups per product type per year; uncertainty published

requirements.text: The mission shall comply with ISED spectrum and debris conditions, the RSSSA licence, ITU procedures and export control.
requirements.rationale: all licences granted before launch; re-entry <= 5 years after end of operations with >= 90 % probability; collision probability < 0.001

requirements.text: The mission shall acquire at least 40 usable scene pairs, each with at most 20 % cloud over the region of interest, covering at least 3 distinct burn scars within 12 months of the end of commissioning.
requirements.rationale: NFI brief year-1 fire target. Verified in orbit from the acquisition log and the cloud mask (in-orbit test).
requirements.source_ref: NFI brief (science targets); research: mission analysis §6.6
requirements.acceptance: >= 40 scene pairs, measured in IOV-SCI

requirements.text: The mission shall observe one complete river- or lake-ice break-up season, from the last fully ice-covered to the first ice-free acquisition, at each of at least 3 community-selected sites between 1 April and 15 June.
requirements.rationale: NFI brief: one full break-up season at >= 3 sites. With ±30 deg roll there are 11-14 opportunities per site per month (research: mission analysis §1.4).
requirements.acceptance: >= 3 sites, measured in IOV-SCI

requirements.text: The mission shall attempt an acquisition at every opportunity within ±30 deg roll over each of at least 3 community-selected ice sites from 1 October until the sun elevation at overpass falls below 15 deg.
requirements.rationale: O3 includes freeze-up. North of 60 N freeze-up after mid-November is not observable in the optical (sun elevation 3-7 deg, research: mission analysis §1.5), so the season is bounded by sun elevation.
requirements.acceptance: >= 3 sites, measured in IOV-SCI

requirements.text: The mission shall acquire at least 10 night-time SWIR images over each of at least 2 burn scars from the previous fire season between 1 March and 31 May.
requirements.rationale: About 30 nadir and 140 roll-30 night looks per site per year (research: mission analysis §1.4). O2 is a test; a null result is an acceptable outcome (MIS-SCI-12).
requirements.acceptance: >= 10 night images per burn, measured in IOV-SCI

requirements.text: The mission shall obtain at least 20 same-day matchups per year with Sentinel-2 or Landsat 8/9 for each product type (burn, ice).
requirements.rationale: Cross-calibration and validation base for O4; Sentinel-2 shares the 10:30 descending node, Landsat crosses at about 10:00-10:15.
requirements.threshold_unit: matchups per product type per year
requirements.acceptance: >= 20 matchups per product type per year, measured in IOV-SCI

requirements.text: The mission shall deliver, for every usable acquisition over a target site, Level-2 burn-index, relative burn-severity class and ice/snow/open-water/cloud class products on a common 60 m grid.
requirements.rationale: NFI brief product list (L1/L2 chain, burn scar, burn index, ice/snow extent). The 60 m grid is where both bands meet the SNR requirement (research: payload §3.4).
requirements.acceptance: statement met as written, measured in IOV-SCI

requirements.text: The ice-extent product shall resolve ice cover on rivers and lakes wider than 175 m (3 product pixels).
requirements.rationale: NFI brief. Resolves the lower reaches of the larger northern rivers at community-selected sites. Verified by analysis of the product MTF plus in-orbit comparison with Sentinel-2.
requirements.acceptance: <= 175 m channel width, shown by analysis in IOV-SCI

requirements.text: The burn-index bias against the dNBR-calibrated Sentinel-2/Landsat reference shall be within ±0.08 over the validation set of each year.
requirements.rationale: NFI brief target. The mission's burn index is NDMI-like (865 nm / ~1.6 um) with about half the dNBR dynamic range (research: mission analysis R9): classes are reported, not dNBR-equivalent values.
requirements.source_ref: NFI brief; research: mission analysis R9
requirements.acceptance: <= 0.08 absolute burn-index bias, shown by analysis in IOV-SCI

requirements.text: The radiometric repeatability of both bands shall be within 5 % (1 sigma) over any 30-day period on pseudo-invariant calibration sites.
requirements.rationale: NFI brief O4 measure; moved from payload to mission level because it depends on the instrument, calibration and processing together.
requirements.acceptance: <= 5 % (1 sigma, 30 days), shown by analysis in IOV-SCI

requirements.text: The geolocation error of Level-2 products shall be at most 120 m (2 product pixels, 1 sigma) after registration to Landsat or Sentinel-2, with winter scenes over snow reported as a separate class.
